registered_by: plan 04.1-15, before any model output exists and before any 2024 outcome is scored

training.example_unit: one example per (cycle, day, batch) from F.batches (D-19)

run_a.if_not_started: skipped; Run B uses 2 epochs with 2022 in-sample (rule S1)
run_a.if_deadline: stopped by its own --deadline-utc; Run B uses 2 epochs (rule S2)

run_b.epochs: the Run A selected epoch, or 2 when Run A was skipped, hit its deadline or failed

training.retry: one pre-registered retry on OOM or NaN (activation_offloading on, then the approved Unsloth stack), otherwise the fallback

systems.base-q4km: un-tuned OLMo 3 converted and quantised by the same recipe
systems.fc-baseline: previous presidential winner by state (2020 for 2024) at p 0.85; chambers persist the 2022 seating result

metrics.parse_rate: mean over compared days of status.json parse_rate (all questions)

primary.name: mean log score over race questions (families senate and governor)

metrics.imputation: a question a system did not parse is imputed by fc.season_eval.impute_missing (the worse of fc-baseline's score and the 75th percentile of the systems' scores for that question and day), so skipping a hard race never improves the primary metric

gate.rule: ship tuned if and only if parse_rate(tuned) >= parse_rate(base) and primary(tuned) <= primary(base) on the compared days
gate.compared_days: days finished by both systems; the three first-ordered days must all be compared

caveats: OLMo 3's data cutoff (Dec 2024) is after the 2024 election, so 2024 is a relative sanity check, not a clean test (D-06)
one cycle and nine correlated days, so differences are descriptive, not significant
base 2024 scores computed before training may not change any training setting; any change is a dated amendment

schedule.train_cutoff_note: Wed 22:00 PDT; no training process runs after it
schedule.run_a_deadline_note: Wed 10:00 PDT; Run A stops itself here so Run B and its one registered retry, 2-6 h each, fit before the train cutoff

waves.work: lock compile and author gates; tracer A (about 150 MediaWiki calls); registration
three venv installs on /mnt/d, base snapshot, template parity; MEDSL, governor and presidential truth with the two-source audit
tracer B on the GPU (10-step smoke train, merge, convert, quantise, base Q4_K_M by the same recipe, runner day); race lists and question sets
live packet and 36 historical packets (about 2.2k uncached parse calls at 0.5 s, 25-50 min, plus the replay); chambers and truth CSVs
poll model, swing simulation, LOCO fit and targets; eval harness and the base 2024 run (35-90 min GPU)
SFT build and tokenisation (about 1 h), then Run A (3 epochs, 2-6 h); Run A starts by 2026-10-20T19:00:00Z
Run B (2-6 h; training ends by 2026-10-22T05:00:00Z), merge, convert, quantise (about 1 h), probe and live-packet runs (about 0.5 h)
tuned 2024 eval (35-90 min), report, gate, model card and launch copy
author login and go-ahead, HF upload, freeze, commit, submit, verify

slippage_rules.S0: A wave among 1-4 finishes after its latest_done_utc: record the overrun and the projected Run A start (now plus the high estimates of the remaining waves before Run A, plus 1 h) in that plan's SUMMARY and continue; nothing is cut, because S1 applies on its own at plan 04.1-09 if the projection holds.
slippage_rules.S1: Run A cannot start by run_a_start_by_utc, including a wave 5 that finishes after its latest_done_utc: skip Run A (runA.json status "skipped"); Run B trains 2018+2020+2022 for 2 epochs with 2022 in-sample (the Run-B-only path).
slippage_rules.S2: Run A reaches run_a_deadline_utc, or fails after its one registered retry: stop Run A (status "deadline" or "failed"); Run B uses 2 epochs, with activation offloading if Run A needed it.
slippage_rules.S3: Run B cannot finish by train_cutoff_utc: Run B runs with --deadline-utc train_cutoff_utc and stops itself; a Run B that is cut short, not started before the cutoff, or failed after its retry is not shipped, and plan 04.1-11 goes straight to the fallback decision with the tuned model unavailable (the base ships) without waiting for fallback_decision_utc.
slippage_rules.S4: The tuned 2024 eval has not finished the three first-ordered days by fallback_decision_utc: the eval stops at fallback_decision_utc and ship_decision returns "base" ("deadline" or "insufficient_days").
slippage_rules.S5: Freeze: the hub receipt must exist before freeze_deadline_utc; plan 04.1-12 halts at its precondition after it. No extension.

fallback.rule: if by fallback_decision_utc there is no tuned Q4_K_M that passed gguf_check and the gate, ship base-q4km
fallback.base_conversion_failed: if our base conversion also failed its load check, ship base-public: the public bartowski Olmo-3-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF that passed the orchestrator probe, frozen with --weights-file
